fields.name: Position
fields.evidence: MSIdleSystem per-frame update bg3.exe+0x1936BB0: for an entity whose template is found it calls FUN_1411966F0(grid, ..., &translate, template+0x5C0) with the entity's Transform translate (view storage stride 0x28, +0x10 qword and +0x18 dword); on success it copies that translate into the component: qword at +0 and dword at +8 (12 bytes = one vec3). Add-helper bg3.exe+0x19375A0 zeroes +0 (qword) and +8 (dword). Live: 0 in all 48 instances.

fields.name: HasPosition
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1936BB0 clears byte +0xC (component stride 0x10) of every instance whose byte is set, and sets it to 1 together with the vec3 copy above; add-helper zeroes it. Live: byte +0xC always 0.

fields.name: _PadD
fields.evidence: Never written by the add-helper or the system (only 13 bytes written); live bytes +0xD..+0xF vary = uninitialised padding.
